_comment: Creature progression (D30). All tunable. Move power multiplies existing combat_math damage, so 1.0 preserves today's balance exactly.
_comment_individuality: R4.2, GAME_DESIGN.md 11: 'same-species creatures have slightly different underlying stat quality.' Each core stat (hp/attack/defence) carries its own 0.0-1.0 quality roll, 0.5 = perfectly average -- variance_pct is the swing at the extremes (0.0 or 1.0), so 0.12 means a stat can run +/-12% off the species base. star_thresholds buckets a roll into 1-5 stars for appraisal display (spec: 'show appraisal through stars/bars, not exact IV numbers') -- four cut points splitting 0..1 into five bands.
_comment_traits: R4.2, GAME_DESIGN.md 11: 'each creature starts with one trait. A second trait can develop later through progression/bond.' unlock_bond_nodes reuses bond.thresholds' own node count -- 5 here means every node crossed, the same 'fully bonded' milestone the Team screen already shows.
